chunks: Which turned everything it touched to ashes.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by the winds turning everything they touch into ashes?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the absolute efficacy of divine decree, where the 'Winnowing Winds' act as an instrument of total annihilation, reducing all resistance to 'dry, crumbled remains' (ramīm). This imagery serves not only as a warning of retribution for the disbelievers of old but also as a metaphor for the fragility of worldly power against God's will, emphasizing that no entity can withstand His command.
